newsitem.title: NIGERIA: SOCCER-NIGERIANS LITERALLY PRAYING FOR VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIGERIANS LITERALLY PRAYING FOR VICTORY.

text.p: Nigerians will be literally praying for victory in the African Champions' Cup final when their team Shooting Stars play Zamalek of Egypt here on Saturday.

"We will have a special prayer session on Friday here in Ibadan. Moslems, Christians, Hindus and Bhuddists will converge and pray for the club's victory, especially for our home match and the away game," club president Taiwo Ogunjobi said.

Ogunjobi, captain of the team who lost to Zamalek 12 years ago, said he had hired a psychologist to boost the morale of the team, adding: "In 1984 we didn't have that opportunity but I think a psychologist has an important role to play in the modern game."

Shooting Stars have set their training camp sentimentally near where the team stayed before the 1976 African Cup Winners' Cup and 1992 CAF Cup finals. They won both trophies and became the first Nigerian club side to achieve the feat.
